basis: renders flow content — aria-hidden glyph, heading and copy — no role asserted.

responsive.basis: one centred column whose geometry is content-driven at every width; the one viewport fact is the vertical padding step py-10 sm:py-14 — breathing room, but a stepped band value all the same, which is why the claim is band-scale and not none.

exceptions.because: the step is one declared class pair (py-10 sm:py-14) on a column whose layout is content-driven at every width — no geometry fact turns on the padding, so a browser leg would witness Tailwind's sm breakpoint, not a pattern-owned fact. Recorded rather than hidden: if the state ever grows viewport-sensitive geometry, this exception is the reminder that the band-scale claim then owes a harness spec.
